findings.reason: the section exists to remove an `UnknownBlockError` caused by a heading that does not resolve, and a node that transcribes the heading from the plan reproduces that same error, so the plan should quote the canonical header verbatim in both places it names it.
findings.text: §12 names the replacement heading as `### The fleet node is for coordination; heavy work goes to a partition`, but the canonical source's header is `### The fleet node is for coordination; heavy work goes to a partition (binding, lead directive 2026-11-10)` (`~/.agents/AGENTS.md:1132`); `block_map` keys blocks by the whole header line and `select_blocks` raises on an exact miss, so setting `FLEET_COMPUTE_HEADER` from the plan's text raises `UnknownBlockError: "canonical source has no block '### The fleet node is for coordination; heavy work goes to a partition'"` (verified in-process)

response_events.note: The canonical heading carries the suffix '(binding, lead directive 2026-11-10)'. §12's repair round selects the block by that full heading line, and its fixture pins it, as the worker reads the live file.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the new canonical heading is quoted twice at `docs/plans/a-worker-is-charged-to-a-job.html:902` without its parenthetical suffix, and `select_blocks` matches header lines exactly, so the quoted form does not resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when is measurable (`worker_digest --check`, digest content, a base-versus-head failure delta, ruff) and names a negative control, the old heading, which I ran: mapping `### On the fleet allocation, run heavy work in place` raises `UnknownBlockError`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the section writes no gate to a scratch path; its outputs are the committed `reckon/crew/digests/*.md` artefacts and the run's own manifest.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the section introduces no plan label, stage name or ticket number new to the plan, and its heading names the mechanism.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated cause reproduces (`python -m reckon.crew.worker_digest --check` raises `UnknownBlockError: "canonical source has no block '### On the fleet allocation, run heavy work in place'"`), and the mechanism produces the done-when: repointing the constant and the SECTION_MAP entries and regenerating yields implement 11,336 estimated tokens (under the 15,000 bound), test 10,011, both carrying the new heading and `sbatch` and neither carrying the old heading, with the regeneration diff confined to the fleet block and the source digest.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s12 carries one deliverable, the digests read the partition rule, and every clause of its done-when measures that one thing.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s12 is declared `implementable` in `plan-section-declarations` with a matching `data-reckon="section"` element, and it needs no `depends-on`: the block it selects lives in the canonical `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`, not in another plan section.
